content.text: Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail: Bitcoin ebook

The reliance on conventional payment platforms often leads to frustration for digital creators. In areas where these platforms have restricted access, creators are left without viable options. COREMERCH addresses this issue head-on by providing a sovereign infrastructure that eliminates dependency on third-party services. With a streamlined setup using NOWPayments, you can accept Bitcoin with minimal fees, retaining 99.5% of your revenue. This foundation empowers you to operate independently, ensuring that your earnings aren’t siphoned off by high platform charges.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before diving into deployment, ensure you have the necessary tools at your disposal. Begin with a GitHub or Cloudflare account for hosting your digital products. Familiarize yourself with Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers for backend processing. Set up a NOWPayments account to handle Bitcoin transactions seamlessly. You’ll also require a system for file delivery, such as Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Lastly, gather your digital products — ebooks, templates, or courses — ready for sale. This infrastructure is your gateway to a robust, self-sufficient online store.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

Once you have your tools ready, it’s time to establish your payment and delivery pipeline. Start by integrating NOWPayments into your infrastructure; it allows you to accept Bitcoin with a mere 0.5% fee—far less than what platforms like Gumroad charge. Next, configure your file delivery system using Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 to ensure swift access for your customers post-purchase. Utilize Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers to automate the process from payment confirmation to product delivery. This setup ensures that your customers receive their purchases instantly, improving their overall experience.
Say goodbye to platform fees — retain 99.5% of your sales.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

With your infrastructure set, it’s time to go live. Publish your digital products on your chosen hosting platform and ensure your payment gateway is active. Promote your ebooks through social media or email marketing to drive traffic to your store. When a customer makes a purchase, the NOWPayments integration will automatically initiate the transaction and trigger the delivery mechanism. Track your first transaction meticulously to ensure everything operates smoothly. This initial sale is crucial; it validates your setup and gives you insights into customer interactions.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

After successfully processing initial transactions, focus on scaling your operations. Analyze customer feedback and sales data to understand which products resonate most with your audience. Expand your offerings and consider bundling products for better sales. As your sales grow, invest in the Complete Builder Kit ($197) to access advanced blueprints and templates, allowing you to enhance your infrastructure further. This investment not only simplifies scaling but also increases your revenue potential without the hassle of traditional platforms.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

You can sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe by utilizing a sovereign digital commerce infrastructure. Platforms like COREMERCH provide the necessary tools to accept Bitcoin payments directly, ensuring low transaction fees and immediate product delivery. This approach allows you to maintain full control over your sales and revenue.
Automate delivery for a seamless customer experience.

If you're looking to sell without relying on platforms like Gumroad or Payhip, consider exploring the Complete Builder Kit ($197) available at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html. This kit equips you with essential blueprints and templates for building a robust digital download store powered by cryptocurrency.
Your Deployment Checklist

Prepare your product files in delivery-ready format — PDF for ebooks, ZIP archives for multi-file products, exported files for Notion templates, OTF and TTF archives for font families. Set your prices in USD and let NOWPayments handle the crypto equivalent calculation automatically at transaction time. Deploy your stack and configure the product list with file paths, USD prices, and delivery settings. Configure your storefront with product pages and checkout flow. Test the checkout on both desktop and mobile — confirm QR codes generate correctly and live price feeds display accurately. Complete a real mainnet test transaction and confirm the delivery email arrives with a working download link. Check your order database and confirm the test transaction appears with all correct fields.
Frequently Asked Questions
How do I set up NOWPayments for my ebook sales?

To set up NOWPayments, create an account on their platform, then integrate the payment gateway into your website using the provided API keys. This allows you to accept Bitcoin payments directly with minimal fees.
What tools do I need to host my ebooks?

You can host your ebooks on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for free. These platforms provide reliable hosting solutions that are ideal for digital creators looking for independence from traditional platforms.
How can I automate product delivery after purchase?

Utilize Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers to automate your product delivery. These tools can be configured to trigger file access immediately after payment is confirmed, ensuring customers receive their products instantly.
What are the transaction fees for using NOWPayments?
NOWPayments charges a low fee of 0.5% per transaction, significantly lower than the 10% fee charged by platforms like Gumroad. This means more profit retained from your ebook sales.
Can I sell other digital products using this infrastructure?
Yes, the infrastructure supports various digital products, including templates, courses, and software. You can easily adapt the setup to accommodate any digital offering you wish to sell.
